data.title: Seiche — funding-stress terminal
data.description: USD funding-stress warning and global money-market context with explicit evidence limits.

environmentVariables.name: SEICHE_MCP_PUBLIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the ten free public tools shipped by seiche 0.10.0 over stdio: latest_article, funding_stress_now, historical_analogs, proof_backtest, data_health, crypto_stress_record, institutional_flows, oil_funding_context, fx_materials_passage, money_market_context.

entries.description: Ten anonymous tools for the latest full-text editorial, current US dollar funding regime, historical analogs, data health, institutional positioning, crypto transmission, oil/FX/material context, granular money-market context, and a historical diagnostic with misses and eligibility flags.
representativeQueries: What is the current US dollar funding stress regime?
What historical episodes most resemble today?
How are hedge funds positioned in the Treasury basis trade?
Are oil, FX or material cash demands—including current Cushing stocks and Brent−WTI basis—reaching dollar funding markets, and which structure figures are dated references?
Explain the latest USD money-market plumbing in simple language and show the source clocks.

entries.description: Curated OpenAPI contract for the granular USD money-market desk, licence-aware global atlas, current funding conditions, market structure, provenance, methodology, and health endpoints.
representativeQueries: Give me an API for the current dollar funding regime.
Retrieve repo, reserves and Treasury cash conditions with provenance.
Check whether the Seiche data feeds are fresh.
Retrieve compact oil-funding, live-vs-reference market structure and FX-material transmission context.
Compare registered money markets against their own native-frequency histories without exposing restricted raw quotes.
